title: Test gap: announce_store heal durability is mutation-untested
description: Found by correctness codereview of project-LICHEN-worker6-s6ml (mutation-verified). Deleting the heal write at announce_store.rs:273 (self.write(iid, true, state)) still passes all 12 announce_store tests. The held-seq assertion at :518-521 passes via the in-memory cache populated by load (:288), and the follow-up accept (:525) rewrites both sides itself, so no test observes that the healed floor was actually durably rewritten - the security-relevant half of the fix that re-arms rollback detection via precedes (:276). The pre-existing store_rejects_state_rollback_and_heals_floor_lag durability claim (:565-572) has the same gap and also passes under the mutation. Fix: after a heal load, assert the floor record exists and verifies, e.g. assert store.read(iid, true) is Ok(Some(state)) (tests module can call the private read) or record_path(floor_root, iid, true).exists().
